content:
Overview

Canberra is a city in Australian Capital Territory with a population of 456,693. Australia’s planned capital with national monuments, museums, and the highest incomes in the country. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
